name: game-theory-negotiation
description: Prepare and run negotiations, procurement auctions, and incentive design. Use for BATNA/ZOPA, walk-away prices, opening offers, concession plans, fairness, bonus or profit-share structures, and game-theory diagrams of players and payoffs. Excludes game-theory homework unrelated to bargaining, auctions, or contracting.
